title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.34852v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24

translated_title: DRBench Pro：面向专业深度研究智能体的以知识为中心的基准测试
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体从多个来源收集信息，并将其综合成关于复杂、开放式问题的报告。现有的基准测试从多个维度评估报告质量，但缺乏专门以知识为中心的评估，即报告涵盖了哪些研究方向以及对其探索的深度如何。我们提出了DRBench Pro，一个将结构化知识覆盖作为主要评估目标的基准测试。我们的自动化流程从维基百科构建局部知识树，并使用采样的子图来生成研究查询和基于证据的评分标准。每个评分标准对应知识树中的一个关系，从而保留了被评估知识的结构。智能体只接收研究查询。这种结构使我们能够衡量跨主要研究方向的广度以及沿相关知识链条的深度，两者的几何平均值即为整体覆盖率。该基准测试包含跨越24个……的144个案例（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: DRBench Pro是一个以结构化知识覆盖为核心评测目标的深度研究智能体基准测试，通过从维基百科构建知识树生成研究查询与证据评分标准，从广度和深度两个维度（取几何平均）衡量智能体对复杂开放性问题的研究覆盖能力。
en_tdlr: DRBench Pro is a knowledge-centric benchmark for deep research agents that uses Wikipedia-derived knowledge trees to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics, measuring knowledge coverage by combining breadth across research directions and depth along knowledge chains via their geometric mean.
